title: What is bypass protection?
body:
What is bypass protection?

Bypass protection helps parents see when a child tries to get around family rules.

What is tracked:
• Incognito and private browsing
• Tor and anonymous browsers
• Proxies, tunnels, and network-protection bypass

Parents get a report of bypass attempts — no mock responses in production.

✅ ALADDIN helps keep rules fair, not punish every click.
